description.p: This is a community package of Music Generator, maintained independently and unaffiliated with rabbitfiremediacreation. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

This is the Vulkan/CPU build. It generates music on the GPU through Vulkan and otherwise on the CPU. The NVIDIA CUDA build is a separate app, de.alphatester.music-generator.Cuda, and is not part of this package. The two can be installed side by side once that package is listed.
Music Generator writes songs on this computer. Models are downloaded when you choose them. No account is required.

Sandbox: display, sound, GPU, and network for model downloads and the optional phone link. Models and songs stay in the app's data folder unless you pick another folder. Updates come through FlatPark.
